                    ### Options

opb. Distance traveled (meters).
opc. Body mass index (BMI).
opd. Forced vital capacity (FVC).

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
The BODE and BODEX indices are both used to assess the severity of COPD, but they include different criteria. The BODE index includes forced vital capacity (FVC), while the BODEX index includes dyspnea assessment (MRC), distance traveled (meters), and body mass index (BMI). Therefore, the criteria that is exclusively part of one of the two indices is FVC, which is only included in the BODE index. The other criteria (dyspnea assessment, distance traveled, and BMI) are part of the BODEX index. Thus, the correct answer is that FVC is exclusive to the BODE index.
